label: POSITIVE_5: Positivity: an undeclared constant P that says, at each world, which properties are…
definition: `Positivity`: an undeclared constant P that says, at each world, which properties (functions from individuals to modal propositions) are positive there. The theory gives it no definition: 'The meaning of P is restricted by axioms' A1a, A1b and A2, and further by A3, A4 and A5. Not Aquinas's perfection; no statement identifies the two.
